summary.zh: B2B 销售预测、配额、留存与定价
summary.en: B2B revenue leadership for forecasting, quotas and retention

description.zh: 面向 B2B 营收负责人，覆盖销售预测、配额设定、销售模式、净收入留存与流失、定价和团队产能。可做收入预测与流失分析。适合季度规划，或增长放缓需要找出原因的时候。
description.en: B2B revenue leadership work: forecasting, quotas, sales model, net revenue retention and churn, pricing and capacity. Includes forecasting and churn analysis. Fits quarterly planning or a slowdown to explain.
